text:
Maria Chen: Starting quick security baseline walkthrough for the new ap-southeast-2 GPU cluster. Need infra+security pairing to validate IAM, secrets, KMS/HSM, network egress, and policy gates before platform handoff. Can we do a 30-45m sync now? :hourglass:

Owen Patel: I can join. Preference: per-pool service accounts for least privilege, not a single cross-project SA. Will prepare policy snippets.

Sophia Li: Agreed per-pool. Quick checklist I'm expecting to clear: no iam:PassRole wildcards, KMS usage restricted to cluster CMKs, secrets served via Secrets Manager (no mounted plaintext), OIDC/workload identity annotated for node SA, and HSM gateway subnet defined.

Alex Rivera: I'll cover cost/quotas: burst pool caps, billing alerts, and confirm no open egress from training subnets. Also want a budget alarm if daily GPU spend > $12k so we don't burn credits in testing.

infra-bot: Compliance scan queued for cluster rwd-ap2 (scan id: cs-1806509876).

Owen Patel: IAM example policy to include in templates:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-2:123456789012:key/RWD-AP2-INFRA-KEY"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":"iam:PassRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/*","Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:PrincipalTag/cluster":"rwd-ap2"}}}
  ]
}
```

Sophia Li: KMS/HSM notes: ap-southeast-2 supports HSM-backed CMKs but requires HSM gateway subnet + TLS termination. We should have two CMKs: infra (rotation 90d) and workload (rotation 30d). Key policies must explicitly allow only the cluster KMS role and the ops oncall principal. Also forward KMS events to central audit log with 365d retention.

Maria Chen: Decision confirmed: infra CMK 90d rotation, workload CMKs 30d. Owen, add modules. Sophia, add gateway subnet details to runbook.

Owen Patel: I'll add terraform module: alias rwd/ap2/infra-key, key_rotation_enabled = true, and include a description with oncall contact (#eng-oncall). Also adding CI policy lint to fail on PassRole wildcards.

Alex Rivera: Networking checklist for verification: 1) training-subnet: egress restricted to S3 endpoints and model artifact registries only; 2) bastion: accessible only from corp VPN CIDR; 3) mgmt-plane: access only from corp IPs + monitoring account; 4) no unrestricted egress 0.0.0.0/0 on high ports.

Sophia Li: I'll add an automated gate to the deployment pipeline that rejects any SG or subnet with egress 0.0.0.0/0 on tcp/1024-65535 and any public S3 ACLs. Command I'll use for scanning pods with mounted secrets:
```bash
kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.volumes[]? | .secret) | [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name] | @tsv'
```

infra-bot: Compliance scan cs-1806509876 complete 7 findings: 1) IAM: role with broad PassRole allowed; 2) Secrets: some pods mounting k8s secret volumes; 3) Network: training-subnet had temporary egress 0.0.0.0/0 on tcp/8080 (temporary debug).

Maria Chen: Prioritize fixes. Owen: patch PassRole denial in role module and add policy test. Sophia: migrate mounted secrets to Secrets Manager and annotate secret rotation. Alex: revert egress and add alerting for manual egress changes. We'll rerun scan after changes.

Owen Patel: PR opened: terraform/iam/passrole-guard. Includes unit test for policy-lint and a KMS key policy assert. Plan to merge after 1 review.

Sophia Li: I pushed a migration job to replace in-cluster secret volumes with SecretsManager CSI driver for pods in training namespaces. Script used: `kubectl -n train patch deployment ...` and added rotation tags: rotation_period=30d for workload secrets.

Alex Rivera: Reverted the egress rule, added alerting: network-change webhook into #eng-oncall and a billing alert if GPU spend > $12k/day. Also set burst-pool quota cap to 30 GPUs until we do a load run.

infra-bot: Re-scan queued (cs-1806509876-rerun).

Owen Patel: Note: ensure CMKs include key usage logs to central CloudTrail and that KMS decrypt is scoped to service account ARNs tied to cluster. Added example terraform snippet to the PR.

Sophia Li: Added HSM gateway subnet to runbook with SGs: allow TLS from KMS endpoints and restrict access to ops subnet. Also included puppet/ansible steps for HSM gateway bootstrap and TLS cert rotation.

infra-bot: Re-scan complete 7 findings remaining: 0.

Maria Chen: Great. Handoff plan: after PRs merge and zero findings, we'll do a 45-min joint verification with product-security and platform, then mark cluster status in the runbook as "security-validated" and attach the compliance scan report. Target: end of day.

Alex Rivera: I'll be on-call for the verification window and will run a smoke load to validate quotas and alerting.

Owen Patel: Merged PR and added CI job `policy-lint:passrole-check` to block merges with wildcard PassRole.

Sophia Li: Secrets migration completed for training namespaces. Added automation to fail rollout if a pod still mounts a k8s secret file.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. I'll update the runbook section (infra/ops/security) with the decisions and links to PRs and scans. Tagging the onboarding ticket: RWD-1248. :white_check_mark:
